export default "

General Accessibility

\n\n

\n The character count message is placed inside an aria-live region using aria-live=\"polite\" so\n that screenreaders can announce character limitation changes as user types\n

\n\n

\n The character count directive also accepts an id value through messageId input\n (auto-generated if not provided). This way users can use aria-describedby on their input to associate the\n character counter with the input\n

\n\n

Theming

\n

\n This component has no variants.\n

\n";
