export default "

General Accessibility

\n

\n Each accordion header uses an element with role=\"heading\", with default heading level of 4. Users may\n pass in the heading level through [headerLevel] property in usa-accordion. This level will\n be applied to all accordion headers in that accordion group.\n

\n

\n Each header also uses a button with [aria-expanded] property to indicate whether the panel is expanded or\n collapsed.\n

\n

If the header is multi-selectable, then [aria-multiselectable] attribute will be applied.

\n

\n The accordion internally uses an incrementing id to ensure uniqueness between each accordion header's ids. Users may\n pass in their own id\n

\n

The accordion uses display: none style to hide collapsed accordions

\n\n

Keyboard Interaction

\n\n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n
KeyFunction
Tab / Shift + TabMove focus to previous and next focusable item
Enter/SpaceOpen / close accordion
Up arrow / Down arrowMove focus to previous and next accordion item in group
Home / EndMove focus to first / last focusable accordion item in group
\n\n

Theming

\n$theme-accordion-border-width\n$theme-accordion-border-color\n$theme-accordion-font-family\n";
