export default "

General Accessibility

\n

\n The breadcrumb component is wrapped around the nav element. This allows assistive tools to identify\n breadcrumbs as a navigational element on the page\n

\n

\n The breadcrumbs are displayed using ordered list and list items element. This allows screen readers to enumarate the\n items in the breadcrumbs as user cycles through them\n

\n

\n The nav wrapper contains aria-label=\"Breadcrumbs\", and the current breadcrumb will have\n aria-current=\"page\"\n

\n\n

Theming

\n\n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n
VariableDescription
$theme-breadcrumb-background-color\n The background color of the complete breadcrumb bar. Default uses body background color set in\n $theme-body-background-color.\n
$theme-breadcrumb-font-familyThe family of the breadcrumb text.
$theme-breadcrumb-font-sizeThe size of the breadcrumb text.
$theme-breadcrumb-gapThe space between indicator icons and text.
$theme-breadcrumb-link-color\n The color of breadcrumb link. Add the link color and the system will generate the hover state. Default uses the\n default link settings calculated from your background color.\n
$theme-breadcrumb-min-widthThe width at which the breadcrumb displays the full breadcrumb list.
$theme-breadcrumb-padding-bottomPadding under the breadcrumb.
$theme-breadcrumb-padding-topPadding above the breadcrumb.
$theme-breadcrumb-padding-xPadding to the right and left of the breadcrumb.
$theme-breadcrumb-separator-colorColor of the breadcrumb separator. This value needs AA contrast against the background.
\n";
